4828-5261-7170.easyPrerequisites:
Benefactor's Draught is exiled by Isochron Scepter.
Isochron Scepter doesn't have summoning sickness.
4828-5261-7170.notablePrerequisites: Creatures you control can tap to produce at least {2}.
4828-5261-7170.description:
Animate Isochron Scepter using Living Brain.
Activate any number of creatures by tapping them, adding at least {2}.
Activate Isochron Scepter by paying {2} and tapping it, casting a copy of Benefactor's Draught without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Benefactor's Draught, untapping all creatures you control and causing you to draw a card
Repeat from step 2.

549-5686-6871--211.easyPrerequisites: You have enough mana to cast the earthbend creature.
549-5686-6871--211.description:
Cast the earthbend creature by paying its mana cost.
When the creature enters, it triggers, earthbending the creature, as it's an artifact due to Biotransference, thus making it also a land due to Toph.
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing the earthbent creature.
When the creature dies, it triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the creature enters, it triggers, earthbending the creature, as it's an artifact due to Biotransference, thus making it also a land due to Toph.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability, creating a Blood token.
Repeat from step 3.
549-5686-6871--211.notes: Depending on the earthbend creature used, you may receive additional results. There may also be needed prerequisites that are specific for each card (such as Bumi, King of Three Trials which requires a Lesson in your graveyard).

645-1267-2719-8095.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
Alesha does not have summoning sickness.
645-1267-2719-8095.description:
Declare Alesha as an attacker.
Alesha triggers, causing you to pay {U/B}{U/B} to return Sakashima of a Thousand Faces from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped and attacking as a nonlegendary copy of Medomai the Ageless.
Deal combat damage using Sakashima of a Thousand Faces.
Sakashima of a Thousand Faces triggers, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing Sakashima of a Thousand Faces
Repeat each turn.

1981-2415-4506-8095.easyPrerequisites:
You control another creature.
You have 2 or more life.
1981-2415-4506-8095.description:
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing a creature.
When the creature dies, Havoc Jester triggers, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Auriok Champion triggers, causing you to gain life
Resolve the Hammerhead ability.
Repeat.

2034-7388--5.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the persist creature.
When the persist creature dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When the persist creature enters, Rocksteady triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on that creature.
Repeat

489-1090-2350-6867.description:
Cast Appa by paying {W}{W}
When Appa enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Restoration Angel with the ability to cast it later from exile.
Cast Restoration Angel from exile by paying {0}.
Appa's second ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Ally creature token
When Restoration Angel enters, it triggers, blinking Appa.
Repeat from step 2.

969-1368-6321-7763.notablePrerequisites: You have at least three other cards in your graveyard.
969-1368-6321-7763.description:
Cast Malevolent Rumble for its escape cost by paying {1}{G} and exiling three other cards from your graveyard, causing you to mill at least three cards and create a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
Repeat.

457-1409-7157-7306.description:
Activate Arcbound Lancer by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
Arcbound Lancer leaves and reenters the battlefield, causing it to enter with +1/+1 counters due to its modular ability, and triggering The Ooze and Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability.
Resolve Deadeye Navigator's trigger, repairing it and Arcbound Lancer
Resolve The Ooze's trigger, creating a Mutagen token for each +1/+1 counter that was on Arcbound Lancer when it left the battlefield.
Activate Urza's first ability twice by tapping Arcbound Lancer and a Mutagen, adding {U}{U}.
Repeat.
457-1409-7157-7306.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you may use it to activate Urza's ability.

2061-5733-7487.notablePrerequisites: You control a Rogue that does not have summoning sickness and that cannot be blocked by an opponent.
2061-5733-7487.description:
Deal combat damage using a Rogue.
Cast Notorious Throng by paying its prowl cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Move to your next turn.
At the beginning of your upkeep, Extravagant Replication triggers, creating a token copy of Zealous Lorecaster.
When the Zealous Lorecaster token enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Notorious Throng from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control

1251-2049-3259.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
1251-2049-3259.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and Ogre Chitterlord as attackers.
Ogre Chitterlord triggers, creating two creature tokens.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to a creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more charge counters on it

1169-1563-2557-3899.description:
Activate Spawning Pit's second ability by paying {1} and removing two charge counters from it, creating two creature tokens
Activate the tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Activate Spawning Pit's first ability twice by sacrificing the tokens, putting two charge counters on Spawning Pit.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

1150-2511-6972.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Melira's Keepers
When Melira's Keepers dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to its static effect.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Repeat.

uses.n: The Enigma Jewel // Locus of Enlightenment

74-617-6893.description:
Activate The Eternity Elevator by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Activate Voltaic Key by paying {1} and tapping it, targeting The Eternity Elevator.
Locus of Enlightenment triggers, copying Voltaic Key's ability, targeting Voltaic Key.
Resolve both Voltaic Key abilities, untapping it and The Eternity Elevator.
Repeat.
74-617-6893.notes: You can tap The Eternity Elevator for colored mana instead if able.

1850-2573-5412.description:
Activate Coastal Hornclaw by sacrificing a land.
Play the land from your graveyard.
Repeat.
1850-2573-5412.notes: If the land can tap for mana once it enters the battlefield, you can do so for infinite mana.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to a creature you control with power 7 or greater that does not have summoning sickness

3398-4050-6525.notablePrerequisites: Hellkite Charger and the creature with Infantry Shield attached cannot be blocked and killed by an opponent.
3398-4050-6525.description:
Declare the creature that has Infantry Shield attached and Hellkite Charger as attackers, triggering the creature and Hellkite Charger. 
Resolve the creature's trigger, creating a number of 1/1 Warrior creature tokens that are tapped and attacking equal to the creature's power.
Holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar seven times by sacrificing seven Warriors, adding {5}{R}{R}.
Resolve the Hellkite Charger trigger, causing you to pay {5}{R}{R} to untap all attacking creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat.
3398-4050-6525.notes: If Hellkite Charger has power 7 or greater, you can attach Infantry Shield to it. Just ensure to resolve the token creation ability first.

539-955-2244-4803.notablePrerequisites: You control a permanent that can tap to produce at least {W}.
539-955-2244-4803.description:
Activate a permanent by tapping it, adding at least {W}.
Activate Nimbleclaw Adept by tapping it, untapping Ruin Ghost and the permanent.
Activate Ruin Ghost by paying {W} and tapping it, blinking Nimbleclaw Adept.
Repeat.

215-3129-4231-5444.description:
Cast Carnage Interpreter by paying {1}{B/R}{B/R}.
When Carnage Interpreter enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating eight Clue, Food and Treasure artifact tokens.
Activate five Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}{B/R}{B/R}{G}.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Carnage Interpreter to your hand from the battlefield.
Repeat.
